name: Arcanist Doan
summary: Within the Scarlet Monastery, Arcanist Doan guards the Athenaeum and its archives. A master human mage, he brings deadly arcane skill to the Scarlet Crusade.

sections.title: Keeper of the Athenaeum
sections.body: The Scarlet Crusade trusts martial fury and holy fervor. Doan believes arcane power is vital to driving the Scourge from Lordaeron. Deep in the Monastery's library, he keeps its lore and guards the Scarlet Key. That key secures Crusade sanctuaries across the northern kingdoms.

faq.q: Why is a mage in the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade is ruled by zealous paladins and priests. Doan believes masterful arcane magic is essential to cleansing Lordaeron of the Scourge.

faq.q: What is Arcanist Doan's connection to the Ashbringer?
faq.answer: Doan has no known connection to the Ashbringer. He guards the Scarlet Monastery's library and the Scarlet Key.

faq.q: What does Doan guard in the Library?
faq.answer: Doan guards the Athenaeum's books and historical records. A lockbox behind him holds the Scarlet Key, which opens the locked gates to the Monastery's Armory and Cathedral wings.

faq.q: What magic does Doan use in combat?
faq.answer: Doan can cast an Arcane Bubble that makes him invulnerable while he channels a massive Detonation spell that fills the room. He can also silence spellcasters across an area and turn threats into sheep.

faq.q: Where did Doan fight during the Third War?
faq.answer: No deeds of Doan during the Third War are recorded. Today he guards the Scarlet Monastery's Athenaeum and the Scarlet Key.

faq.q: Does Doan harbor any personal secrets?
faq.answer: Doan serves the Scarlet Crusade as an arcanist. No record speaks of his private romantic attachments.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see Doan's mastery of arcane defenses in the protective bubble he casts.
As a paladin, you meet a rare arcanist trusted by the Scarlet Crusade, an order that prizes the Light above all other powers.
As an Alliance fighter, you see how the Scarlet Crusade's zeal binds even a master of the arcane to its violent paranoia.
As a member of the Horde, you face a dangerous Scarlet commander whose library holds vital intelligence and keys to the Crusade's inner sanctums.
